claim: Socratic interrogation (clarification, causal probing, counterexample-based interrogation) improves physical consistency, hypothesis completeness, uncertainty calibration, and downstream experimental-plan validity compared to generic review, which improves surface-level completeness but is less effective at exposing missing causal links or specifying conditions under which a conclusion could fail.
falsifier: One could implement a multi-agent system with a Socratic questioning module and a generic review module, then compare the quality of generated hypotheses and experimental plans on a set of scientific problems.

conditions: in the context of multi-agent autonomous scientific discovery
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported multi-agent system (Duzhi) and the specific experimental tasks; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: Socratic interrogation–physical consistency, hypothesis completeness…

claim: A multi-agent system with specialized agents bridges communication barriers between computational chemists, synthetic chemists, and analytical scientists who traditionally work in isolation.
falsifier: One could deploy a similar multi-agent system in a pharmaceutical research setting and measure cross-disciplinary communication frequency or collaboration quality before and after deployment.

conditions: agents are specialized for different phases of drug discovery
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported multi-agent system and its simulated workflow; transfer to other team compositions or real-world settings is unestablished.

title: Multi-agent system with specialized–bridging of communication…

claim: In high-contrast space coronagraphy, post-processing that uses all relevant existing data to disentangle a planet signal from residual stellar contamination pushes exoplanet detection limits beyond the instrument raw contrast limit.
falsifier: On a coronagraphic dataset with known injected planets, compare detection limits before and after applying a post-processing pipeline that uses all relevant data; the pipeline should recover fainter planets than the raw contrast limit.

conditions: after instrument acquisition, residual stellar contamination remains in the science data
the post-processing operates a posteriori on the science data
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported high-contrast imaging context and the reviewed instruments; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Post-processing that uses all–exoplanet detection limits principle
